content.text:
Updated `src/solution.py` to remove unnecessary validation restrictions while preserving the function signature and input data.

It returns `True` only when all requests fit and at least one resource has positive capacity remaining. Empty resources and unmet requests return `False`.

Verified with 15 targeted cases and 2,187 exhaustive cases in both request orders.
